def valley_indices(lst):
    def is_valley(pos):
        left = lst[pos - 1]
        right = lst[pos + 1]
        center = lst[pos]
        return center < left and center < right
    return [pos for pos in range(1, len(lst) - 1) if is_valley(pos)]

from collections import deque

def rotate_string_right(s, n):
    if len(s) == 0:
        return ''
    letters = deque(s)
    steps = n % len(letters)
    letters.rotate(steps)
    result = ''.join(letters)
    return result

def is_repdigit(n):
    text = str(abs(n))
    ordered = sorted(text)
    smallest = ordered[0]
    largest = ordered[-1]
    return smallest == largest
